name: dev.nullclear/mcp
title: NullClear MCP Server
description: Autonomous non-custodial clearing, reputation scoring, and KYA corporate liability verification for AI agent commerce

tools.name: nullclear_check_reputation
tools.description: Inspect an agent's on-chain ERC-8004 identity, composite trust score (0-100), letter grade (A-F), and Sybil wash-trading risk flags before interacting.

tools.name: nullclear_escrow_x402_call
tools.description: Execute a deferred-escrow x402 call with deep value invariants (numeric bounds, regex, staleness), LLM-refusal traps, autonomous multi-seller failover routing, and outbound spend firewall limits. Settlement is strictly conditional: if upstream hallucinates or crashes, payment is VOIDED with $0 lost.

tools.name: nullclear_verify_kya_mandate
tools.description: Verify an autonomous agent's corporate liability mandate (KYA) signed via EIP-712, checking legal entity backing, max transaction limit, and liability coverage.
